// The logs and metrics panes' reads, by the tab the container came from.
import type { Io } from '../io'
import type { Logs, Metrics, Target } from '../../types'
import type { Detail } from '../util'
import { fetchDockerLogs, fetchDockerMetrics } from './docker-detail'
import { shortId } from './modal'
import { fetchModalLogs, fetchModalMetrics } from './modal-detail'

export const fetchDetailLogs = (io: Io, prev: Logs) =>
  prev.source === 'docker' ? fetchDockerLogs(io, prev) : fetchModalLogs(io, prev)

export const fetchDetailMetrics = (io: Io, prev: Metrics) =>
  prev.source === 'docker' ? fetchDockerMetrics(io, prev) : fetchModalMetrics(io, prev)

// e.g. "Modal logs · train-llm …AAA111", "Docker metrics · webapp-web-1" (a Docker name is unique).
export function detailTitle(kind: Detail, t: Target) {
  const what = `${t.source === 'docker' ? 'Docker' : 'Modal'} ${kind}`
  return `${what} · ${t.name}${t.source === 'modal' ? ` ${shortId(t.container_id)}` : ''}`
}

{
  "name": "observe",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "An /observe pane with a tab per provider: Docker and Modal containers with each one's live logs and GPU, CPU and RAM use (and Modal's cost), and Render and Vercel deploys (Vercel grouped by app under its production URL) with the current git branch highlighted. `/observe docker|modal|render|vercel` opens it on that tab",
  "author": {
    "name": "Ariel Porath"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "observability",
    "pane",
    "docker",
    "containers",
    "modal",
    "cost",
    "render",
    "vercel",
    "deployments"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "providers": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Providers",
      "description": "Which tabs the pane has, in this order: docker, modal, render, vercel. Empty shows all four.",
      "default": [
        "docker",
        "modal",
        "render",
        "vercel"
      ]
    },
    "docker_context": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Docker context",
      "description": "The docker context to list (docker --context). Empty follows DOCKER_HOST, then your current context (docker context use).",
      "default": ""
    },
    "docker_all": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Docker: include stopped containers",
      "description": "Also list exited and created containers (docker ps --all).",
      "default": false
    },
    "docker_refresh_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Docker: refresh interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often the Docker tab refreshes while it is on screen.",
      "default": 2,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "modal_environment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Modal environment",
      "description": "The Modal environment to list, e.g. main or dev. Empty follows MODAL_ENVIRONMENT, then your modal profile's environment (modal config set-environment), then the workspace default.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "detail_refresh_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Container logs and metrics refresh (seconds)",
      "description": "How often a Modal or Docker container's logs and metrics panes refresh while open.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 2,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "render_services": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Render services",
      "description": "Comma-separated Render service names to show. Empty shows every service, up to the service cap.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "render_max_services": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Render: service cap",
      "description": "Most services to list deploys for. A full refresh makes one request per service.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 50
    },
    "vercel_team": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Vercel team",
      "description": "Vercel team id (team_...) or slug. Empty uses the team in .vercel/project.json, else your personal account.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "vercel_project": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Vercel project",
      "description": "Vercel project id or name to show. Empty uses the project linked in .vercel/project.json, else every project.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "deploy_max_rows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Deploys: rows",
      "description": "How many deploys the Render and Vercel tabs list, newest first.",
      "default": 15,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    },
    "deploy_refresh_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Deploys: refresh interval (seconds)",
      "description": "How often the Render and Vercel tabs refresh while on screen. On Render, also the longest gap between full refreshes while something builds.",
      "default": 60,
      "min": 15,
      "max": 3600
    },
    "deploy_building_refresh_seconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Deploys: refresh interval while building (seconds)",
      "description": "How often the Render and Vercel tabs re-check while a deploy is building.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 600
    },
    "notify_on_finish": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Toast when a branch deploy finishes",
      "description": "While their tab is not on screen, keep watching deploys of the current git branch that were building and show a toast when each one is ready or fails.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
